entries.notes: Placeholder entry. Replace with a real term from your domain. The 'should' policy means the target is preferred but not mandatory.
The 'must' policy means at least one of the listed targets must be used when translating this source term. Skrebe will flag it as an error otherwise.
The 'avoid' policy is the forbidden-terms list. Skrebe will flag the target term if it appears in a translation, suggesting alternatives. Use for terms you want translators NOT to use.
